_doc.what: Template for a ~60 s talking-head reel with one promptDemo beat: the steady-funk-bed preset, one licensed track as a single bed from 0 to the end, and an extra music duck under the demo. Replace the reel name, the track file (or use a Mixkit track: mixkit_id + tag instead of file), its bpm and cue, and the end time.
_doc.style: Style preset name (music_presets/<name>.json, made by ref_audio_profile.py from the reference creator's reels) or 'none'. Its mix block gives the defaults for section level, duck, eq, SFX levels, the SFX auto map and SFX samples; anything set in this plan wins. music_verify.py checks the result against the preset's measured ranges.
_doc.tone_map: Story beats from the transcript. Documentation for the edit and the verify image; sections implement it. In the reference style the music does NOT follow the tone (one bed, no switches, no stops); the SFX mark the turns.
_doc.tracks: Key -> a local licensed 'file' (absolute, or relative to this plan) or a Mixkit track (mixkit_id + tag; fetched to ~/.cache/reel-music/mixkit). No music ships with this skill: use a track you have the licence for. bpm: measured with music_fetch.py analyze (check kick spacing; trackers often report 2/3 or 3/2). Audition candidates against the preset with ref_audio_profile.py tracks first.
_doc.grids: One tempo fitted to anchors (story beats) so they land on bar lines (snap 'bar') or beats (snap 'beat'); 'bpm' overrides the fit. Tracks on a grid are atempo-stretched to it (keep within ~8%).
_doc.sections: cue = a downbeat in the source (s; snapped to the nearest kick onset within cue_tol), placed on reel time cue_at. level = target LUFS of the music while the speaker talks (default from the style preset, -27.2 for steady-funk-bed). in/out: fade, cut, join, xfade, sweep_in, sweep_cut, filter_out, tape_stop, button. dropouts: mute between two grid-snapped times, track keeps time. Reference style: a single section 0 -> end, in cut, out cut.
_doc.duck: Optional override of the style's ducking (steady-funk-bed: 0.1 dB, i.e. a constant bed). depth_db while talking, attack/release s, lead = start ducking before the word.
_doc.eq: Optional override of the style's music bus EQ (steady-funk-bed: hp 35 Hz, -5 dB at 3 kHz q 0.7, lp 9.5 kHz).
_doc.sfx: auto = sounds on graphic entrances from edit.json via the style's auto_map (steady-funk-bed: sub boom on title cards, whoosh into a big boom on a screen takeover, nothing else). skip by overlay id or 'id:kind'; extra hits may snap to a grid; samples = licensed Mixkit SFX by id (mixkit_sfx) or a local file, else synthesized by sfx.py; levels: dB relative to the speech's per-word loudest 100 ms.
_doc.master: Constant gain to lufs (fails if it would move the speech more than max_speech_change_db); true-peak guard trims only music+SFX.
_doc.duck_windows: Extra music-only duck under audible product demos. duck_demos (default true) adds every promptDemo overlay's row span from edit.json at demo_duck_db (default 8 dB); duck_windows adds manual [start, end, extra_db] spans. music_verify checks each drop.

tone_map.tone: one confident groove under the whole reel (reference style: no switches, no stops)
tone_map.music: your licensed track from its first full groove bar, level under the voice, ducked a further 8 dB under the demo, hard cut with the last frame
